name: 19126 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19126 (Philadelphia) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19126 (Philadelphia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
